instruction: How much revenue did we get from EMEA customers this quarter?
sql: SELECT SUM(i.amount) AS emea_revenue FROM invoices i JOIN customers c ON i.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE c.region = 'EMEA' AND i.status = 'paid' AND i.issue_date >= DATE_TRUNC('quarter', CURRENT_DATE);

instruction: List all open SEV1 incidents with the assigned engineer's name
sql: SELECT inc.incident_id, inc.opened_at, e.first_name || ' ' || e.last_name AS assigned_to FROM incidents inc JOIN employees e ON inc.assigned_to = e.emp_id WHERE inc.severity = 'SEV1' AND inc.status IN ('open', 'investigating') ORDER BY inc.opened_at;

instruction: Which department has the most active projects?
sql: SELECT d.dept_name, COUNT(p.project_id) AS active_projects FROM departments d JOIN projects p ON d.dept_id = p.dept_id WHERE p.status = 'active' GROUP BY d.dept_name ORDER BY active_projects DESC LIMIT 1;

instruction: Show me the top 5 customers by annual recurring revenue
sql: SELECT company_name, region, tier, arr FROM customers WHERE is_churned = FALSE ORDER BY arr DESC LIMIT 5;

instruction: How many hours did the engineering team log last week?
sql: SELECT SUM(t.hours) AS total_hours FROM timesheets t JOIN employees e ON t.emp_id = e.emp_id JOIN departments d ON e.dept_id = d.dept_id WHERE d.dept_name = 'Engineering' AND t.work_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '7 days';

instruction: Which equipment has had the most emergency maintenance in the last 90 days?
sql: SELECT eq.equip_name, eq.site_id, COUNT(ml.log_id) AS emergency_count FROM equipment eq JOIN maintenance_logs ml ON eq.equip_id = ml.equip_id WHERE ml.work_type = 'emergency' AND ml.log_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '90 days' GROUP BY eq.equip_name, eq.site_id ORDER BY emergency_count DESC LIMIT 10;

instruction: What is the average time to resolve SEV2 incidents?
sql: SELECT AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (resolved_at - opened_at)) / 3600) AS avg_hours_to_resolve FROM incidents WHERE severity = 'SEV2' AND resolved_at IS NOT NULL;

instruction: List all contracts expiring in the next 30 days that are not set to auto-renew
sql: SELECT con.contract_id, cust.company_name, con.contract_type, con.end_date, con.value FROM contracts con JOIN customers cust ON con.customer_id = cust.customer_id WHERE con.end_date BETWEEN CURRENT_DATE AND CURRENT_DATE + INTERVAL '30 days' AND con.auto_renew = FALSE ORDER BY con.end_date;

instruction: Show overdue invoices with the customer name and days overdue
sql: SELECT c.company_name, i.invoice_id, i.amount, i.due_date, (CURRENT_DATE - i.due_date) AS days_overdue FROM invoices i JOIN customers c ON i.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE i.status = 'overdue' ORDER BY days_overdue DESC;

instruction: How many employees are in each salary band?
sql: SELECT salary_band, COUNT(*) AS headcount FROM employees WHERE is_active = TRUE GROUP BY salary_band ORDER BY salary_band;

SELECT p.project_name, p.budget, SUM(t.hours * 150) AS estimated_cost FROM projects p JOIN timesheets t ON p.project_id = t.project_id WHERE p.status = 'active' GROUP BY p.project_name, p.budget HAVING SUM(t.hours * 150) > p.budget ORDER BY (SUM(t.hours * 150) - p.budget) DESC;

instruction: Show me all chillers that are past warranty
sql: SELECT equip_name, site_id, model_number, warranty_end FROM equipment WHERE equip_type = 'chiller' AND warranty_end < CURRENT_DATE ORDER BY warranty_end;

instruction: What is the total maintenance cost per equipment type this year?
sql: SELECT eq.equip_type, COUNT(ml.log_id) AS visits, SUM(ml.cost) AS total_cost FROM equipment eq JOIN maintenance_logs ml ON eq.equip_id = ml.equip_id WHERE ml.log_date >= DATE_TRUNC('year', CURRENT_DATE) GROUP BY eq.equip_type ORDER BY total_cost DESC;

instruction: Who are the managers with the most direct reports?
sql: SELECT m.first_name || ' ' || m.last_name AS manager, COUNT(e.emp_id) AS direct_reports FROM employees e JOIN employees m ON e.manager_id = m.emp_id WHERE e.is_active = TRUE GROUP BY manager ORDER BY direct_reports DESC LIMIT 10;

instruction: List enterprise customers in NA region that have not churned
sql: SELECT company_name, arr, acq_date FROM customers WHERE tier = 'enterprise' AND region = 'NA' AND is_churned = FALSE ORDER BY arr DESC;

instruction: What is the average project duration for completed projects?
sql: SELECT AVG(actual_end_date - start_date) AS avg_days FROM projects WHERE status = 'completed' AND actual_end_date IS NOT NULL AND start_date IS NOT NULL;
